title: Regarding 3D modeling workflow - custom skills & stack
author: delusion54
selftext:
Are you using one or more custom skills for this process? I think I overcomplicated my SKILL md and takes too long, but most results are improved in many ways(not sufficiently though). I am specifically troubled by 3d creatures models, because of the troubles hands and join transitions produce.

For context, my setup is codex, higgsfield blender mcp, blender, godot. I usually feed an image from various angles, and ideally image(choose preferable among many, and ask for the character in a transparent background or greenscreen)-->video generation attempt of fixed object idle stance and rotation of camera 360 arround it with steady zoom, horizontally and then in a 2nd video vertically-->spritesheet --> codex starts.

If you have any input, much appreciated.
